newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi International secures $5 mln backing.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi International secures $5 mln backing.

text.p: Kiwi International Air Line and Wasatch International Corp said Wednesday they have signed a $5 million debtor-in-possession financing agreement enabling Kiwi to begin scheduled flights in certain cities.
The financing plan is scheduled to be considered by U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Newark on Thursday.
If it is approved, Kiwi said it will release an outline of its plan to resume scheduled service on November 4.

Wasatch will loan Kiwi up to $5 million in the form of a 10 percent secured note. It also has indicated it will provide additional equity financing that will allow Kiwi to strengthen its cash position and for future growth activities, Kiwi said.
